title: Tia | Questions with a date, a stage name or a status give wrong answers ("no leads created last month" when there are 1,153), and amounts cannot be summed
summary: Plain counts are right, but as soon as a question has a date range, a picklist label or a status condition, Tia answers "none" or fails. Tia also cannot add up an amount field.
steps: Sign in to CRM as the Owner and open Tia.

Ask each question in a new chat: How many leads were created last month? / How many leads were created this month? / How many leads were created today? / How many leads were created in October 2026? / How many deals are in the Closed Won stage? / How many tasks are not completed yet? / What is the total amount of all deals?
Compare with the Leads, Deals and Tasks lists filtered the same way.
expected: Tia gives the same numbers as the filtered lists: last month (October) 1,153; this month 2; today 1; Closed Won 3; tasks not completed 121; total deal amount 5,533,912,086,090.
actual: Last month, this month, this week and today: "No leads were created … based on the records you can access" (today also once "Sorry, I couldn't answer that just now"). October 2026: "The app is currently not responding". Closed Won: "There are currently no deals in the Closed Won stage". Tasks not completed: "Sorry, I couldn't answer that just now. Please try rephrasing your question." Total amount: "I do not have the total amount of all deals available from the data."
more: "How many deals are in the stage closed_won?" (the internal value) gives the right answer, 3, so the stage label is not matched to its value.
Each question was asked twice with the same result.
Right in the same run: leads created last week (0), tasks I own (0), the largest deal (AP-75), and plain module counts (25 of 27 right in an earlier run).

title: Tia | Screen readers do not announce Tia's answers, and messages are not marked as yours or Tia's
summary: The Tia panel has no live region and the chat is not marked up as a list of messages, so a screen reader user does not hear when Tia answers and cannot tell who said what.
steps: Open Tia with a screen reader running (or inspect the panel's accessibility tree).
Send: How many deals are there?
Then send a request that returns a card, for example: Create a lead with first name "QA" and last name "Reader". Prepare the card for me to confirm.
expected: "Thinking…" and each new answer are announced (polite live region). Each message is announced as from you or from Tia, inside a message list (role log or list). Card content is separate from the next message.
actual: No element in the panel has aria-live or role status/log; the "Thinking…" indicator has no role. In the accessibility tree the user's question is plain text and Tia's answer a paragraph, with no speaker. The count card and the next question are read as one line: "Count 73 Total: 73 Create a lead with first name …".
more: Checked through the browser accessibility tree in Edge (what NVDA/JAWS read); no screen reader is installed on the test machine.
Fine: the panel is a dialog named "Tia", all buttons have names, focus goes to the message box when the panel opens and stays there after an answer.

title: Tia | In Firefox, the Tab key gets stuck on the Send button
summary: With the keyboard, Firefox users cannot move past the Send button in the Tia panel.
steps: Open CRM in Firefox and open Tia.
Click in the message box and type a few letters.
expected: Focus moves from the message box to Send and on to the next control (in Edge it moves on).
actual: Focus moves to Send and stays there on every further Tab. Shift+Tab moves back normally.
more: Edge and WebKit move past Send (there focus then leaves the panel, see NDC-3260).

title: Tia | The "Ask Tia" button does not tell screen readers whether the panel is open
summary: The launcher button has no expanded state and is not linked to the panel.
steps: Inspect the "Ask Tia" button before and after opening the panel.
expected: The button has aria-expanded (false/true) and aria-controls pointing to the panel, so screen readers say "collapsed/expanded".
actual: The button only has the name "Ask Tia"; aria-expanded and aria-controls are missing in both states.
